errors.text: The proposed optimum is 900 °C, whereas the target optimum is SPS at 1000 °C.
The alloy chemistry is replaced by a generic Mg-Ti-Zr-Hf-Nb system rather than the MgAlTiVFeCo composition and its ball-milled BCC starting state.
The mechanism suppresses secondary phases, while the target mechanism depends on uniformly distributed oxide barrier phases such as AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3.
The falsification experiment does not compare intermediate sintering temperatures against 1000 °C and omits the required oxidation test at 900 °C and corrosion test in 3.5 wt% NaCl.
The cited studies concern non-Mg high-entropy or refractory alloys, so they do not substantiate the claimed Mg volatility, phase stability, density thresholds, or oxidation/corrosion mechanism.
